citation: Grammich, Clifford, Erica Dollhopf, Mary Gautier, Richard Houseal, Dale E. Jones, Alexei Krindatch, Richie Stanley, and Scott Thumma. 2023. 2020 U.S. Religion Census: Religious Congregations and Membership Study. Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies.
note: The U.S. Religion Census is county level by policy: it does not collect or publish congregation names or addresses. A Christian Education Market Area is a group of whole counties, so the join is exact and no congregation is estimated into a place it might not be.

markets.name: Port St. Lucie–West Palm Beach, FL

inventory.note: An inventory of located places, not a count of congregations. It over-counts where one congregation is recorded as several places and under-counts where a small church has no record at all. It is published beside the census count and never instead of it.
